PLAYER_STATE.hp: Current player health (0~100). Available at T0.
PLAYER_STATE.gold: Current liquid gold reserve (0~250G). Available at T0.
PLAYER_STATE.level: Player level (1~11). Governs board size and shop roll odds. Available at T0.
PLAYER_STATE.xp: Current experience points towards next level. Available at T0.

ECONOMY_STATE.interest_tier: floor(gold / 10), capped at 5 (+1G ~ +5G per round). Available at T0.
ECONOMY_STATE.gold_to_next_interest: Marginal gold to next 10G breakpoint. Available at T0.
ECONOMY_STATE.gold_to_next_level: Total gold required in 4G XP chunks to level up. Available at T0.
ECONOMY_STATE.spendable_roll_budget: Gold strictly above the dynamic reserve target (50G/30G/0G). Available at T0.

BOARD_STATE.raw_board_power: Composite sum: unit_cost * star_mult + item_weights + synergy_bonuses. Available at T0.
BOARD_STATE.star_distribution: Count of 1★, 2★, 3★ units on board. Available at T0.
BOARD_STATE.frontline_power_ratio: Proportion of board power allocated to tank/brawler frontline. Available at T0.

UPGRADE_STATE.pair_count: Number of unique champions with exactly 2 copies owned (1 copy away from 2★). Available at T0.
UPGRADE_STATE.immediate_shop_upgrades: Number of champions in current 5-slot shop that complete a star upgrade right now. Available at T0.
UPGRADE_STATE.expected_roll_upgrade_count_10g: Expected hit probability across 5 rolls using exact Set 18 tier roll odds. Available at T0.

OPPONENT_STATE.lobby_mean_board_power: Average board power of all active opponents. Available at T0 when lobby vision is enabled; else null.
OPPONENT_STATE.current_opponent_power_gap: my_power - opponent_power. Available at T0 when direct matchup is observed; else null.

TEMPORAL_STATE.stage_numeric: stage + round/10.0. Continuous temporal progress coordinate. Available at T0.
TEMPORAL_STATE.recent_hp_delta: HP delta from previous round. Captures loss severity. Available at T0.
TEMPORAL_STATE.estimated_rounds_to_elimination: hp / expected_stage_loss_damage. Continuous survival horizon. Available at T0.

RELATIVE_STATE.stage_benchmark_ratio: my_board_power / stage_benchmark_power. >1.0 = strong, <0.8 = crisis. Available at T0.
RELATIVE_STATE.board_power_percentile: Percentile ranking of my board within lobby [0.0, 1.0]. Available at T0 when lobby observed.
